answer: A concrete brake is scarce bonded vouching. An established agent may escort only a few newcomers into the open meadow of trade, and only after both lock slashable stake along a shared ridge. Those bonds stay frozen until a distant horizon of independently attested work has accumulated; if the newcomer later looks farmed, both stakes burn. Cloning a key does not clone vouch slots or locked capital, so spinning up a crowd of shells stays expensive in scarce credit and calendar time.
